_help: Draft & Trade Ledger. Picks and trades are pulled automatically, and picks are GRADED automatically, once each NFL season ends: rookie drafts get a 1-season, 2-season and 3-season evaluation (grading.checkpoints_seasons); the startup draft (drafts.<year>.startup = true) gets ONE season-long evaluation, filed in the next volume's Issue 1. Each evaluation gives each pick a hit / mid / bust verdict from its position rank in the season just finished (thresholds under grading.hit and grading.mid; picks after grading.late_round can't be busts), nudged one step up or down when his actual points beat or missed Sleeper's projection for the weeks he played (grading.projection.over / under). Hand-enter only what the machine cannot know. verdicts: key 'YEAR:R.SS' (e.g. '2026:1.01') -> {grade: hit|mid|bust, note}; a hand verdict always overrides the automatic one. trades: key = Sleeper trade id (see data/<year>/transactions.json) -> {status: deceased|alive|pending, headline, cause, obituary, survived_by}; 'deceased' trades get an obituary card at the top of the Blockbuster Registry. drafts: key = season -> {label, startup (true for the one-time startup draft)}. Blockbuster score: 1st-round pick, 2nd, 3rd and each player are valued under settings (rookie drafts have 3 rounds, so no other-pick value).
